blocks.html: Pasig City, Philippines — RLC Residences officially opens the doors to RLC Residences Expo 2025: Hello, Home, Forever—the first developer-curated expo in the Philippines dedicated to celebrating what a home truly means: a place to begin, grow, and build a life that lasts. Happening from June 20 to 22, 2025 at Park Avenue, Bridgetowne, Pasig City, the three-day event brings together thoughtfully curated experiences, exclusive offers, and expert insights to help home seekers find not just any space, but the right one—their “forever” home.

The expo also marks a meaningful milestone for its parent company, Robinsons Land, as it celebrates 45 years of building quality developments and communities. The event pays tribute to this legacy—highlighting the company's continued evolution and unwavering commitment to creating spaces that improve lives.

The event commenced with a ceremonial ribbon-cutting led by top executives of RLC Residences, Mr. John Richard Sotelo, Chief Marketing Officer of Robinsons Land and Senior Vice President, Business Unit General Manager of RLC Residences; Ms. Stephanie Anne Go, Vice President and Head of Business Development and Design; Ms. Czarina Lugue, Assistant Vice President and Head of Business Development, Ms. Carissa Denise Lao, Vice President and Overall Head of Sales; Mr. Dan Carlo Torres, Marketing Director and Head of Brand Management and Operations; and Ms. Karen Cesario, Senior Director, Marketing Head and Chief Integration Officer.

“RLC Residences Expo 2025 is more than a showcase of our developments—it’s a celebration of our commitment to helping people find a home they can truly grow with and come home to forever,” shared Sotelo. “Through this event, we aim to make the journey to homeownership more exciting, accessible, and deeply meaningful for every Filipino and global investor.”

True to the theme Hello, Home, Forever, the expo offers an immersive, curated experience that brings the essence of home to life. Through three experiential zones, guests are taken on a matchmaking journey—connecting them with the right property, the right sellers, and the right set of exclusive deals tailored to their needs and aspirations.
At the Hello Zone, guests are welcomed with a look into RLC Residences’ identity as the residential arm of Robinsons Land, tracing its 45-year legacy of building quality, purpose-driven communities.

In the Home Zone, attendees can explore the brand’s diverse and growing portfolio of developments—from condominiums to house-and-lots or lots-only projects—located in key urban and emerging cities nationwide.

Finally, the Forever Zone invites guests to envision their long-term future through partner booths and insightful real estate talks by respected names in the industry. These include representatives from real estate services companies Cushman & Wakefield and Lobien Realty Group; Content Creator, Financial Advocate and founder of Ready2AdultPH Charm De Leon; Content Creator, Founder and Mayora of Home Buddies Facebook Community Frances Cabatuando; Content Creator, Licensed Filipino Architect and Principal Architect of Delta Archi Studio Ar. Dax Augustus; and RLC Residences Brand Ambassador Heart Evangelista.

The expo is also packed with exclusive offers designed to make the homeownership journey more rewarding. Subject to applicable terms and conditions, these include the Pre-Selling 120 promo, which allows buyers to avail of the featured pre-selling property by paying the discounted price in 120 months; free SMEG oven toaster for the first 100 booked units; monthly rebates for maximum 45 months via GoTyme for expo buyers who will book the featured units; and an additional 10% discount on top of existing applicable discounts for the first 45 booked sales. On top of that, daily raffle prizes will be awarded to lucky expo visitors throughout the three-day run.

These exclusive expo deals are on top of ongoing RLC Residences promos, such as the Early Move In and Lease-To-Own programs for ready-for-occupancy projects—giving home seekers even more flexibility and value as they invest in their future home.

This year’s expo is made possible in partnership with IKEA, SMEG, The Westin Manila, Café Summit, GoRewards, True Value, BPI, BDO, Metrobank, PSBank, and GoTyme, whose presence adds value to the holistic homeowner experience being celebrated at the event.

“We named this year’s event ‘Hello, Home, Forever’ because we believe home is not just where life begins—it’s where it continues to grow,” Sotelo added. “Our goal is to create spaces that stay relevant not just today, but for every chapter of our homeowners’ lives. That’s what forever means to us.”
To learn more about RLC Residences developments, visit rlcresidences.com.
